chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from some of his companions, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Yūnus, who said:
I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about carrying the جنازة from its four sides. He said:

If you are in a situation of taqiyyah, then begin with the right hand, then the right foot. Then return from your place to the right sides of the deceased; do not pass behind his feet at all, until you face the جنازة and take its left hand, then its left foot. Then return to your place; do not pass behind the جنازة at all until you face it, doing as you did the first time.

And if you are not practicing taqiyyah in it, then the method of carrying the جنازة from its four sides that the sunnah (prophetic tradition) has established is that you begin with the right hand, then the right foot, then the left foot, then the left hand, until you go around it.

key_terms.الرِّجْلِ الْيُسْرَى: the left rear side/foot position in the carrying order
key_terms.الرِّجْلِ الْيُمْنَى: the right rear side/foot position in the carrying order
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the normative established practice transmitted in religion
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةَ: the funeral bier or deceased being carried
key_terms.الْيَدِ الْيُسْرَى: the left front side/hand position completing the carrying order
key_terms.الْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى: the right front side/hand position from which carrying begins
key_terms.تَرْبِيعِ الْجَنَازَةِ: carrying the جنازة by its four sides in a specific ordered manner
key_terms.تَقِيَّةٍ: dissimulation or precautionary concealment in circumstances of danger or sensitivity

ai.seo_question: What is the correct Shia method of carrying a جنازة from its four sides, especially in a situation of taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the prescribed order for carrying a جنازة from its four sides, distinguishing between circumstances of taqiyyah and ordinary practice. It preserves a practical funerary sunnah (prophetic tradition) from Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام and shows how legal practice may vary depending on conditions of dissimulation and safety.
